count_flags.note: ToLaD#68. no_current_range: living leaves with a PHYLACINE map but an empty current range (PHYLACINE's current range is IUCN's without 'possibly extinct' areas). IUCN CR/EW ones are capped at 50 (CR criterion D, IUCN Categories and Criteria v3.1) unless a history file gives a cited count; the rest (DD/LC/unassessed: unmapped, mostly taxonomic) are flagged only. Their natural baseline takes the density route. cr_modelled_above_10k: IUCN CR/EW species whose today's count is still modelled and above 10000 (the ceiling of IUCN criterion C): candidates for a census anchor, not changed. today = the shipped alive count.

mu_cite: Armstrong et al. 2025, Genome Biol Evol 17:evaf060 (Pantherinae pedigree rates)
ne_over_n_cite: Frankham 1995, Genet Res 66:95-107 (Ne/N ~0.1 over comprehensive estimates)
diversity_crosscheck.note: Layer 2 of the estimate stack (ToLaD#63), a cross-check only (not used in the counts or curves): N_div = het / (4 mu_year G) / (Ne/N), grade D. het = genome-wide heterozygosity of one individual (Zoonomia). A long-run size over ~4 Ne generations, not a dated level. dex_* = log10(N_div / other).

source.cite: Wilder et al. 2023, Science 380:eabn5856 (Zoonomia), Table S1: genome-wide heterozygosity

genomic.note: Layer 3 of the estimate stack, bulk (ToLaD#64): PSMC Ne histories from Bergman et al. 2023, rescaled and converted as pipeline/history/README.md 'Deep past' says. used = the curve became the leaf's deep past (a history file's [deep], or a modelled record). Per-species points, drops and the join to the next level are in history.species[<leaf>].deep.

source.cite: Bergman et al. 2023, Nat Commun 14:7679, Supplementary Data 3 (PSMC Ne trajectory)

ghost_lineages.allocation: crown membership: a ghost at time t is credited to the parent of each reconstructed lineage crossing t, in proportion to the present-day wild births of that lineage's extant descendants
ghost_lineages.births_now_note: wild births only (no humans, no domestic stocks)

deep_join.note: How each genomic deep past meets the next level across PSMC's blind spot (ToLaD#77, #80): a cited next level (a history file's baseline or first point) scales the curve to meet it (rule `scaled`, factor = 1 / ratio); a modelled one (the natural level in 1500 CE, today's modelled count) keeps the genomic level (rule `absolute`). ratio = genomic level at the blind spot / next level, before scaling; flagged when beyond 10x either way. Per species: history.species[<sp>].deep.join (its `note` is the card's sentence).

history.note: Curated flagship histories (pipeline/history/). ever_before = the model alone (the natural baseline before 1500 and the range-loss trend after it where it differs from today's count, else today's count, over the band); ever_after = with the curve. deep_from = what sets the level at the band start: `genomic` (a [deep] genome-based curve, older than any cited point, baseline included), else `baseline` (cited), else `natural` (the natural baseline), else `today`. deep_before / deep_after = the level at the band start. Leaf values, before the tree sum.

natural_baseline.note: Layer 1 of the estimate stack (ToLaD#61): N_nat = density x PHYLACINE present-natural range x occupancy, grade D, kind reconstruction. Extant species: today's count x natural/current range cells (the same occupancy and area scale as today's count). No current range: density x natural area (rescaled to PanTHERIA areas) x fitted occupancy. Held before 1500 where it differs from today's count; extinct species: the whole band.

current_vs_pantheria_dex.note: log10(PHYLACINE current range area / PanTHERIA GR_Area_km2), extant leaves with both. COMBINE carries no range area (only home range), so PanTHERIA is the model's only observed range. Small ranges are inflated by the 96.5 km grid.

rangeloss.note: Layer 4 of the estimate stack (ToLaD#62): an extant species whose natural baseline (layer 1, PHYLACINE present-natural vs current range) differs from today's count changes log-linearly from N_nat in 1500 CE to today's count in 2026.77 (IUCN's 'since 1500' window, one date for all). factor = N_nat / N_today (> 1 = decline). HIST kind 11 `rangeloss`, grade D. A history file replaces it (showcase rows with from=history: the factor shown is the model's, the curve is the history file's).

stem_rehoming.rule: fossil-only subtrees older than the Upham 95% HPD upper bound of an enclosing crown node are moved to that crown's stem (inside a total-group node)

unverified_extant_tips.note: Open Tree tips treated as living that no extant-species list (Upham, PHYLACINE, Greenspoon/IUCN) recognises: recent splits, synonyms, and some fossils without an extinct flag. Their counts come from the occupancy model only.
